title: Study in France
tagline: Public universities and business schools. Programs in French and English.
intro:
France combines strong public universities with affordable tuition and renowned business schools. You can study in French or choose an English-taught program — especially at master’s level.

We shortlist programs, help with motivation letters and documents, and prepare you for the student visa.
services: Choosing a university, school or language course
Motivation letters and CV in French/English

sections.heading: Education system
sections.body: The French system follows **Licence (3 years) — Master (2 years) — Doctorat**. Public universities offer a wide range of fields; business and engineering schools (grandes écoles) offer more practical and usually more expensive programs.

sections.heading: Language
sections.body: French-taught programs usually require DELF/DALF. English-taught programs require IELTS or TOEFL. If your French needs work, start with a language course in France.

steps.title: Consultation
steps.text: We choose the level, language and type of institution.

steps.title: Applications
steps.text: We apply and follow up on responses.

steps.title: Visa
steps.text: We prepare the student visa package.

faq.q: Can I study in France in English?
faq.a: Yes, especially at master’s level and in business schools. There are fewer English-taught bachelor’s programs.
Public universities are relatively affordable by European standards; private schools cost noticeably more. We find options within your budget.
Yes, students may work a limited number of hours per year, which helps cover part of the costs.
